On the girls side our own Jessica Dash won the Girls 800 metres, and of the boys, Sean McLean and Stanley Osuide were first and second in the high jump while Peter Lloyd took the 800 metres.
Sean McLean sailed over 2.00 for the third time in three weeks to stamp his authority on the Youths high jump and it was pleasing to see Mark Jackson run a pb in the junior 1500m.

Stanley went on to clear 2.15m later in the season with Sean McLean not far behind clearing 2.08m. All those of you who are not well up with field events go and measure these heights in your living room now and marvel that these are Young Athletes launching themselves to such heights!

Sean McLean was awarded man of the match for his high jump. Sam Debell and Peter Lloyd did the double in the boys' high jump and 800m, while James Drake and Alex Breeze also won both strings in the colts' 800m.
